title: Regression: Stale uid_cache.bin crashes the running game when the debugger inspects resources
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in 4.7.rc2

- Not reproducible in 4.5 stable, 4.5.1 stable, 4.6.3 stable

### System information

Godot v4.7.rc2 - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 3 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Ti (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.9186) - AMD Ryzen 7 9800X3D 8-Core Processor (16 threads) - 63.61 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Surround 7.1)

### Issue description

(NOTE: **Title outdated**, maybe not uid related)

In Godot 4.7 only, while running the game from the editor, if I click the Video Ram tab in the debugger the game instantly close with no warning or error: 

- No error in the debugger
- Nothing in Output in editor
- Nothing in the console window
Basically, exact same result as if I pressed Alt+F4, but I'm just trying to open the Video Ram tab.

Also _in certain scenes only_, anytime I try to open the Remote Tree, the same crash happens.
If I open the remote tree while in another scene, then change the scene to one of the "bugged" ones, it crash instantly too. So the issue is caused by trying to display/access the remote tree, not _clicking_ the button.

Another occurrence: I have a node with an @export var containing a dictionary of textures. With this node, I can open the remote tree, but if I select the node in the remote tree, then the crash happens instantly. I suspect one of the texture resources in the dictionary has a "bad" (duplicate?) uid.

~I just solved ALL of these issues by deleting the /.godot/uid_cache.bin file.~ (Edit: probably wasn't what helped, rather, restarting the editor temporarily make the issue disappear)

So the regression is : ~Having a "bad" uid_cache make the game crash while running it from the editor, only in Godot 4.7. Even tho having a bad uid_cache isn't something that should happen, this is still a new bug -> no crash in other versions with that same uid cache~ Edit: Something (unknown) is making the debugger close the game.

### Steps to reproduce

- Have a bad uid_cache (details unknown :/)
- Run the game in editor
- Click "Video Ram" -> crash  (simplest step since "Remote tree" is scene-dependent)

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

I don't know how to make a MRP for this.
I still have a backup of the project folder with the bug present. Sadly, I'm not allowed to share it. But I'm willing to run tests on it to help get more information, please tell me what you need.
